token.label: Notion token
token.description: Paste your personal access token from https://app.notion.com/developers/tokens

list.label: Start page (optional)
list.description: Leave empty to start from your top-level pages. Or paste a link to a page or database to start there: in Notion, ... menu > Copy link.

logo.label: Notion logo
logo.description: Shows the Notion logo at the left of the screen, for photos and videos. Off: the list takes the whole screen.

scope.label: Show
scope.description: Which rows a database shows, when it has a date. A page always shows all its to-dos, ticked or not.
